# Proposal Quality Review

**Proposal:** [Name]  
**Reviewer:** [Name]  
**Review date:** [Date]

## Buyer and Scope Integrity

| Check | Pass | Revision needed | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Proposal names the buyer’s actual decision or delivery objective | ☐ | ☐ | |
| Recommended offer fits the qualification evidence | ☐ | ☐ | |
| Scope is bounded and understandable | ☐ | ☐ | |
| Client responsibilities, inputs, and access needs are explicit | ☐ | ☐ | |
| Exclusions and assumptions are visible | ☐ | ☐ | |
| Milestones and acceptance conditions are testable | ☐ | ☐ | |
| Price and payment timing are clear | ☐ | ☐ | |
| Change-control process is stated | ☐ | ☐ | |

## Evidence and Claim Safety

| Check | Pass | Revision needed | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| No fabricated customer reviews, ratings, case studies, or results appear | ☐ | ☐ | |
| No external-platform, revenue, ranking, uptime, or ROI guarantee is implied | ☐ | ☐ | |
| Any example is clearly labeled and appropriate to the buyer context | ☐ | ☐ | |
| Technical, legal, security, or operational uncertainties are not hidden | ☐ | ☐ | |

## Delivery and Team Sustainability

| Check | Pass | Revision needed | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A delivery owner can accept the scope within current capacity | ☐ | ☐ | |
| Required skills, access, and review time are feasible | ☐ | ☐ | |
| Escalation path is clear | ☐ | ☐ | |
| The engagement can end cleanly with a useful client handoff | ☐ | ☐ | |

> A proposal that fails a material quality check is revised, re-scoped, or respectfully declined. Speed does not justify an unclear commitment.
